en.28:1: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to see the tomb.
en.28:2: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from heaven, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
en.28:3: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
en.28:4: The guards trembled in fear of him and became like dead men.
en.28:5: But the angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
en.28:6: He is not here; He has risen, just as He said! Come, see the place where He lay.
en.28:7: Then go quickly and tell His disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him.’ See, I have told you.”
en.28:8: So they hurried away from the tomb in fear and great joy, and ran to tell His disciples.

en.16:1: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so they could go and anoint the body of Jesus.
en.16:2: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
en.16:3: They were asking one another, “Who will roll away the stone from the entrance of the tomb?”
en.16:4: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone had been rolled away, even though it was extremely large.
en.16:5: When they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
en.16:6: But he said to them, “Do not be alarmed. You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here! See the place where they put Him.
en.16:7: But go, tell His disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see Him, just as He told you.’”
en.16:8: So the women left the tomb and ran away, trembling and bewildered. And in their fear they did not say a word to anyone.

en.24:1: On the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women came to the tomb, bringing the spices they had prepared.
en.24:2: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb,
en.24:3: but when they entered, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.
en.24:4: While they were puzzling over this, suddenly two men in radiant apparel stood beside them.
en.24:5: As the women bowed their faces to the ground in terror, the two men asked them, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?
en.24:6: He is not here; He has risen! Remember how He told you while He was still in Galilee:
en.24:7: ‘The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and on the third day rise again.’”
en.24:9: And when they returned from the tomb, they reported all these things to the Eleven and to all the others.
en.24:10: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them who told this to the apostles.
en.24:11: But their words seemed like nonsense to them, and they did not believe the women.
en.24:12: Peter, however, got up and ran to the tomb. And after bending down and seeing only the linen cloths, he went away, wondering to himself what had happened.

en.20:1: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
en.20:2: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved. “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb,” she said, “and we do not know where they have put Him!”
en.20:3: Then Peter and the other disciple set out for the tomb.
en.20:4: The two were running together, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
en.20:5: He bent down and looked in at the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
en.20:6: Simon Peter arrived just after him. He entered the tomb and saw the linen cloths lying there.
en.20:7: The cloth that had been around Jesus’ head was rolled up, lying separate from the linen cloths.
en.20:8: Then the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went in. And he saw and believed.
en.20:9: For they still did not understand from the Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.
en.20:10: Then the disciples returned to their homes.
